results.text: Efficacy and safety of brexpiprazole in adolescents with schizophrenia: a multicountry, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial with an active reference. New treatment options are needed for adolescent schizophrenia, partly due to an unfavourable risk-benefit profile of current options. This trial aimed to evaluate the short-term efficacy and safety of brexpiprazole in adolescents with schizophrenia.
